Decision register

DecisionPoC choiceProduction question
Entity allocation3 UK / 8 Asia / 3 Americas / 5 MENAT / 11 EuropeApproved legal-entity inventory and exact incorporation/operating countries.
Physical storesSingapore, London and New York, one node eachRequired country stores, HA, recovery placement and provider/site custody.
OwnerOne master per entity/customer relationshipField ownership for genuinely shared profiles and identity matching.
ReadsCurrent owner-policy check; no offline readsAny bounded offline-read permission and accepted revocation window.
TransportDirect adapter + durable pollingCDC/Kafka or another approved regional transport.
MigrationRead-only catalog planner plus isolated executed India migrationApproval, barrier, rollback and cutover protocol.
PerformanceProcess lock and eventual projectionsMeasured latency, contention, throughput and acceptable lag.
TelemetrySynthetic global view; regional evidence targetApproved aggregate export and customer investigation workspaces.

No union of rights

A person may have relationships with multiple entities. The least restrictive relationship cannot be used to export data owned by another. If a composite response joins records, evaluate every source dataset and field provenance independently. Do not simply union all the customer’s allowed destinations.

Co-location is a trade-off

Sharing a physical store reduces node count and can support local transactions, but increases operational blast radius. Use separate credentials, entity-scoped enforcement and, where required, database or cluster separation. A composite primary key prevents collisions; it is not an authorization control.

For implementers: engineering brief
HAND OFF TO ENGINEERING

Build this component

A focused prompt with scope, contracts and acceptance criteria.

Read the full prompt
Extend the v3 operational PoC, preserving 30 legal entities and three independent single-node store models. Business data is normalized across 12 tables; sovereignty policies live in parallel control tables. A separate party scope exports only id/global_party_id/party_type; relationship scopes export connected whitelisted graphs. Global distribution still needs grants and approved geography; deny overrides. Do not infer relationship access from a global party, common store or shared identity. Keep the single local transaction and asynchronous destination acknowledgement distinct. The hosted UI is a labelled browser simulation. The unified Docker/CockroachDB/OPA suite and live Chromium generator/migration walkthrough passed. Database crash boundaries, accessibility and pilot load remain separate gates. Use synthetic data only. Deliver bounded adapters, actual migrations, meaningful invariant tests and honest run results.

Apply the normalized operational extension before the earlier component requirements below.

Create ADRs for entity ownership, physical co-location, identity matching, read availability and migration. Identify decisions requiring bank policy owners rather than guessing from country names. Preserve the distinction between record-key design and actual authorization enforcement.
